question_text: How many distinct cameras produced at least one event between 09:00 and 10:00 UTC on 2025-12-08 (the morning keynote hour)?

gold.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT camera_id) AS active_cams FROM events WHERE timestamp_utc >= '2025-12-08T09:00:00Z' AND timestamp_utc < '2025-12-08T10:00:00Z'

metadata.note: Tests COUNT(DISTINCT camera_id) restricted to a one-hour window.
